text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We've made it to spring of Mayano Top
Gun's
senior year. Recently, her training
has been...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Boring! Running around the track three
times is no
fun!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Let me do thirty! I can do it now!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
What?! Then hurry up and think of
something else
we can do for training!
choice_data_list: それは脚に無理させすぎだ
それは脚に無理させすぎだよ

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: I know you'll make me do something fun!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Wait, I've already mastered everything
on the list
you gave me yesterday. Other
than that... ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...Her days of requesting new training
methods
from me continue.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But if Mayano Top Gun has set herself a
goal, it's
my job as her trainer to support
her.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Morning, Trainer! Let's give it our all
today!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Trainer? You look really pale...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: T-Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thud.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Oh my. That was close.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: You almost fell over.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Haha, no need to thank me. You're
surprisingly
light.
choice_data_list: もしかして君が支えて……？
もしかして貴方が支えて……？

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Oh? There are dark circles around your
eyes. You
don't seem to be getting
proper sleep.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Come here, Mayano!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: W-waaah!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Don't be scared! I just want a word!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Eek!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
There you go, Trainer. You rest here a
little.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I'll take care of her.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Haha, don't worry. I'm not gonna eat her
or
anything.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
To tell you the truth, that challenge she
laid down
after the Arima Kinen was...
quite tantalizing.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: That's why I want to be in the mix too.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
There's no way I can let you keep such
an
interesting girl all to yourself.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Whaaaa?! Hishiama?!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Nooo... I mean, sorry! It's just I'm
completely
devoted to my trainer—and
only to my trainer!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Calm down. I'm just making a suggestion.
Don't
you want to improve?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Well, Trainer? Will you entrust her to me
for a
bit?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon. The Queen of the
Amazons. Narita
Brian's rival at the
Arima Kinen both this year and
last.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I have to think about what's best for
Mayano Top
Gun. Instead of obsessing
over my own plans, it
might be necessary
to put her in Hishi Amazon's
care.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
There ya go! Let Hishiama's training
begin!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Which means, Mayano, you're gonna
run, and I'm
gonna chase you. If I grab
your tail, I win.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
You mean tail tag? I haven't played that
since I
was in kindergarten...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Does that really count as training? Isn't
that just
playing?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Oh? You underestimate me. Let's try it
out.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ugh... Urk...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Oh my. What do we have here? You've
already
been caught more than ten
times!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
That's because you're not playing fair,
Hishiama!
You can't just add more
people to be it!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Haha! I'll get you next, Mayano!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Oh, you guys look like you're having fun.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Hishiama, would you mind if I joined
you? I'd love
to help.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Of course! Thanks! Now, Mayano...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Your weakness is your lack of awareness.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...Awareness?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I know how to be aware. And I know how
to play
this game.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
You're the one suddenly adding more
people to
be it and changing the rules! I
don't even wanna—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, that's why... You know what?
It's fine.
You're purposefully closing your
eyes to it.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: To what?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
From what I can tell, you've been
blessed with
both talent and an
excellent trainer.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
With those two things, you can do
anything.
That's why the adults around
you do so much for
you.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: In turn, you've gotten spoilt.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Take now, for example. If only you just
tried to
grasp the situation...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Basically, you've fallen into the habit of

dismissing that which you don't already
know.
You aren't even trying to learn
anything new.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
We're not playing tail tag right now.
We're
training for a race.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Think. In a real race, you have loads of
other
racers coming for you. Their
strategies change in
real time.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
So what do you do? You react to those
changes,
twist your body, run away, and
so on... Right?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: ...And now think about this morning.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Do you not realize that your trainer has
been
working so hard because of you?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
You're a brilliant runner. But will you put
your
brilliance to use?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Or will you be a child who just cries and
gives up,
causing even more pain to her
trainer?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Nooo! Definitely not!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna grow up! I'm not gonna cry!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hishiama! Let's do it one more time! I
won't let
you catch me again!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Haha, all right. I'll give you a head start!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: No! Let's do it right! I've figured it out!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
All right! That's what I wanted to hear!
Feel it not
in your mind, but in your
body!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Under the glowing sunset, Mayano Top
Gun and
her friends run around the track
over and over
until they're dripping with
sweat.
